code_generation_rust.input: Write a Rust function to check if a string is a palindrome

output.code: fn is_palindrome(s: &str) -> bool { let cleaned: String = s.chars().filter(|c| !c.is_whitespace()).flat_map(|c| c.to_lowercase()).collect(); cleaned.chars().eq(cleaned.chars().rev()) }

summarization.input: Climate change refers to long-term shifts in global temperatures and weather patterns. sql_generation.schema:
users (id, name, email, created_at)
orders (id, user_id, total, order_date)
sql_generation.request: Find all users who have placed orders totaling more than $1000

output.sql: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, SUM(o.total) AS total_spent FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email HAVING SUM(o.total) > 1000;
